vb_textbox.text: Tap the spacebar once.  The color of the gnomes hats correspond to the color of the basket. Alternate between the colors when the mushrooms drop lower. Yellow yields a higher amount of mushrooms. Red baskets are determined by colors closer to red, eg brown and purple. yellow baskets are determined by colors closer to yellow e.g green and blue. all the best
